title: English for International Economics and Business

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and write various types of business letters in international trade.
Understand and draft international business contracts including export-import, technology transfer, joint ventures.
Understand and prepare various trade documents such as invoices, transport documents, insurance certificates, customs declarations.
Write proposals for international investment projects.
Develop independent work skills, professional teamwork, adaptability to changing environments.
Achieve minimum IELTS score of 5.5 or equivalent.
Develop self-learning abilities, accumulate and enhance specialized English language knowledge.
Apply critical thinking to solve problems related to international economics and business.
